caveats: Every person, subject, address and id in this corpus is invented. Nothing in it is read from a mailbox, a ledger or a log.
Each case reproduces the condition a signal tests: the timestamps, recipients, subjects and token overlaps the scrubber reads, and nothing else.
This corpus scores closure_scrubber's signals. It does NOT score ledger_sync (inbox-as-completion) nor the briefing's LLM closeability pass.
Signal 8 (project_member_completion) reads the project store, which the harness sandbox does not seed, so no case exercises it.
`unactionable` and `contested` entries are recorded and NOT scored.
`discriminating` is false when no scored scrubber build closes the case, so holding it proves nothing (closure_harness.py audit).
